company_info.size: 1,001-5,000 employees (approximately 1,400-2,683 employees based on recent data)
company_info.industry_info: Computer and Network Security / Identity Security. 1Password is a password management and identity security platform founded in 2005 that helps millions of customers and over 165,000 businesses (including IBM, Slack, Canva, and Salesforce) secure their access and manage identities.
company_info.recent_news: 1Password received $100M in secondary market funding (November 2025). Company is valued at $6.8B. Layoffs reported in 2025-2026 have created some job security concerns among employees. The company has been named to Rising in Cyber 2026, recognized by 150 CISOs and senior security leaders. Recent focus on securing access for human and AI identities.
company_info.company_culture: Remote-first company with strong benefits and generally positive work-life balance. Employees praise supportive colleagues, meaningful work, and company values focused on collaboration and transparency. However, recent changes include frequent reorganizations and shifting priorities that have created change fatigue. Some employees report inconsistent communication and concerns about job security due to layoffs. Company culture emphasizes challenging the status quo, experimentation, and fast-paced work. A people-first approach is evident but tempered by demanding work standards and expectation for excellence. Middle management consistency has been variable based on employee reviews.
company_info.any_related_information: 1Password is a well-established, profitable company (est. $782.7M annual revenue) founded in 2005. The company emphasizes AI adoption in development workflows and encourages responsible use of AI tools during hiring process. Travel for in-person engagement is required as part of remote-first role. The company has experienced significant growth (35% employee growth last year). Interview process uses AI/ML for initial screening; candidates can opt out. This is for an existing vacancy. Company leadership appears engaged but organizational changes have created some instability.
